checks.null_unit: one bijection of candidate-parent labels shared by all query rows, independent streams across datasets; no pairwise or cellwise shuffling
checks.top1_ties: fractional 1/k credit for k exactly tied minima retains exact chance 1/n
checks.mrr_ties: reciprocal average ranks; null mean computed over all rank-matrix cells rather than assuming the untied harmonic formula
checks.jackknife_unit: delete matching query row and initialization candidate column together, rerank the remaining nine candidates
checks.jackknife_scale: normalize rank, top1 and MRR for the smaller candidate set and back-transform raw summaries to the original full-n chance/ceiling scale
checks.aggregate_variance: sum centered delete-one-run variances separately within each dataset stratum, including equal-dataset weighting
checks.pvalues: 10000 global bijections; add-one lower-tail rank test; p comparisons include numerical equality; Holm only for the three prespecified E20 dataset endpoints

interpretation_limits: Ten complete trajectories per dataset; unbounded normal jackknife intervals are descriptive approximations, especially for discrete top1 results.
Saved float32 null summaries are compact diagnostics. Exact p-value reproduction should use saved float64 candidate ranks and the saved identity mappings.
A run seed controls both initialization and minibatch order, so retrieval identifies training lineage rather than an isolated causal effect of initialization.
